name: enable_module
label: Enable Module
help_text: When off, the module outputs nothing. Use to keep the module in the page flow but hide it from view.

name: custom_id
label: Custom ID
help_text: Adding a custom ID here will replace the default custom ID.

name: custom_classes
label: Custom Classes
help_text: Enter your additional, custom classes here for additional styling options in your css.

name: background_video
label: Background Video
help_text: Add multiple file formats in order to provide compatibility with a broad range of browsers. This field is used when Background Option is set to Video.

name: default_panel
label: Default Panel
help_text: These settings apply when the Default Panel is enabled. Disable it to have the first Tab/Accordion Item act as the default panel instead.

children.name: panel_enabled
children.label: Enabled
children.help_text: Toggle to enable the dedicated default panel experience. When disabled, the first Tab/Accordion Item becomes the default panel and the settings below are ignored.

children.name: enabled
children.label: Show Default Panel in Accordion View
children.help_text: When enabled (and the Default Panel is turned on), this panel will appear above the accordion items in accordion view.

children.name: default_content_type
children.label: Content Type
children.help_text: Choose whether the default panel shows the content fields or a HubSpot form. Selecting Form switches desktop tabs to click-to-activate so visitors don't lose their place while completing the form.

children.name: form_id
children.label: HubSpot Form
children.help_text: Select the HubSpot form to display in the default panel.

children.name: redirect_url
children.label: Redirect URL
children.help_text: Optional URL to redirect to after form submission.

children.name: button_style_override
children.label: Button Style
children.help_text: Override the form submit button with a Sprocket Rocket button style.

children.name: content
children.label: Content
children.default: This is the default panel content. It is visible by default in tab view and can be optionally shown above the accordion in accordion view.

children.name: tab_position

children.help_text: Choose whether tabs appear at the top or left of the content area.

children.name: force_accordion_xl
children.label: Force Accordion View on XL Screens
children.help_text: If enabled, the module will display as an accordion on all screens 992px and wider instead of tabs. This will also force accordion view on LG screens.

children.name: force_accordion_lg
children.label: Force Accordion View on LG Screens
children.help_text: If enabled, the module will display as an accordion on large screens between 992px and 1199px instead of tabs.

children.name: tabbed_min_height
children.label: Tabbed View Minimum Height (px)
children.help_text: Sets a minimum height for the tabbed content area on desktop to prevent layout shifts with short content.

children.name: bottom_of_tab_spacing
children.label: Bottom of Tab Spacing (px)
children.help_text: Controls the spacing between the tabs and content when the tabs are positioned along the top.

children.name: tab_gap
children.label: Tab Gap (px)
children.help_text: Controls the spacing between adjacent tabs when no tab border is applied. When a tab border is enabled, the gap automatically collapses so borders align cleanly.

children.name: equally_spaced_tabs
children.label: Equally Spaced Tabs
children.help_text: When enabled, top-positioned tabs expand to share the available width evenly.

children.name: max_tabs_visible
children.label: Max Number of Tabs Visible
children.help_text: Set how many top-positioned tabs should be visible before horizontal scrolling is introduced. Leave blank to disable.

children.name: padding
children.label: Spacing
children.help_text: Margin above and below and padding around the the insite of the container
